<h1>Md Bodrud-Doza</h1>
<p class="appointment">PhD in Geography · Postdoctoral Scholar</p>
<p class="affiliation"><a href="https://geg.uoguelph.ca/">Department of Geography, Environment and Geomatics</a><br><a href="https://www.uoguelph.ca/">University of Guelph</a>, Canada</p>
<p class="hero-intro">I study how agricultural landscapes can sustain food production while protecting water, soil, and ecosystems.</p>
<p>I bring together geospatial analysis, environmental monitoring, machine learning, and process-based modelling to understand environmental risks and support better landscape-management decisions.</p>

## From evidence to better decisions

<div class="cards three"><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">What I study</p><h3>Landscapes & resilience</h3><p>Agricultural landscapes · Water quality · Food-system resilience</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">How I work</p><h3>Spatial evidence & models</h3><p>Earth observation · GeoAI · Environmental monitoring · Geospatial analysis · Machine learning · Process-based modelling</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Why it matters</p><h3>Decisions that fit place</h3><p>Better targeting · More resilient landscapes · Evidence-informed decisions</p></article></div>

## Current research directions

<div class="cards three"><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Established foundation</p><h3>Precision & multifunctional conservation</h3><p>Target conservation where it can deliver water-quality and wider landscape benefits.</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Emerging methods</p><h3>Earth observation & GeoAI</h3><p>Extend geospatial and modelling expertise toward agricultural and environmental intelligence.</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Developing direction</p><h3>Food-system resilience</h3><p>Explore how stress signals and system buffers can inform anticipatory decisions.</p></article></div>
